{{Quote|Permission to deliver the killing stroke, my Lord?|A Jilruan attendant, to Lord Gar-Oth|<ref name="Starcrash" />}}
The '''Jilruans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jilrua]], located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] portion of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] near the [[Oktos Nebula/Legends|Oktos Nebula]]. 

Having been conquered by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species, they served Hutts, [[t'landa Til]], and [[Yahk-Tosh]] in various roles, from [[Aide/Legends|attendands]] to [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiators]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Many Jilruans fought in the [[Xim Wars]], with many [[Death/Legends|dying]] in the [[Second Battle of Vontor]]. Some Jilruans served as attendants to [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Gar-Oth]], a Yahk-Tosh warlord. Having conquered a [[Lourdes' homeworld|planetoid]], the warlord was attacked by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Lourdes]], heir to the planet's [[King/Legends|monarchy]]. When he overpowered her, one of the Jilruan attendants requested permission to carry out the [[Death/Legends|killing]] stroke, but was prevented by one of Lourdes' [[Skeeter|aides]]. Lord Gar-Oth's attendants were later crushed by the warlord's own [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[Goliath (droid)|Goliath]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Jilruans were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Towering and war-like,<ref name="Atlas" /> the Jilruans had two [[Limb/Legends|arms]] that ended in five-fingered hands. They had blue skin, yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], no discernible [[Nose/Legends|nose]], and white [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. While in service to [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Gar-Oth]], Jilruans wore purple robes with hoods that cast their face into shadow, although their glowing eyes to remain visible.<ref name="Starcrash" />

==History==
[[File:Vong_vs_Hutts.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Jilruans engage Yuuzhan Vong forces.]]
The Jilruans evolved on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jilrua]], located near the [[Oktos Nebula/Legends|Oktos Nebula]]. Their [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was conquered [[Standard year/Legends|millennia]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species, becoming part of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. They were integrated into Hutt society as [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiators]], retainers, and attendants for not only their Hutt overlords but also members of the [[t'landa Til]] and [[Yahk-Tosh]] species as well. Although found offworld in that capacity, their homeworld itself was rarely visited by offworlders.<ref name="Atlas" />

In the year [[25,100 BBY]], Jilruan [[flecheteer]]s and cavalry equipped with [[Cyborrean battlemount]]s contributed to the militia forces of Hutt [[General/Legends|general]] [[Kossak Inijic Ar'durv]], and fought in the [[Second Battle of Vontor]] against the forces of [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] the Despot. These Jilruan units, fighting alongside [[Cyborrean]] and [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] mercenaries, suffered massive [[Death/Legends|casualties]], but managed to decimate the last of Xim's organic forces, his [[Duinarbulon Star Lancers]].<ref name="Xim Week: The Despotica">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek02/index.html|text=Xim Week: ''The Despotica'' (Part I)|int=Xim Week: The Despotica}}</ref><ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref><ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-3-xim-the-despot|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 3 - "Xim the Despot"}}</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], which raged from [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] to [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], Hutt Space initially remained officially neutral. However, when the extra-galactic [[Yuuzhan Vong]] learned that the Hutts were selling intelligence on Yuuzhan Vong military movements to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], they invaded Hutt Space.<ref name="Atlas" /> Several Jilruans engaged the Yuuzhan Vong in combat as part of a multi-species, Hutt-commanded militia.<ref name="EGtW" />

==Jilruans in the galaxy==
{{Quote|Lord Gar-Oth demands audience.|A Jilruan translates from Yahk Tosh|<ref name="Starcrash" />}}
At least [[Unidentified Jilruan pirate|one Jilruan]] worked as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] during the [[Kymoodon Era]]. This Jilruan ended up being captured by authorities on the planet [[Belasco/Legends|Belasco]], and&mdash;while in custody&mdash;divulged that the [[Utoradii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] was planning a [[Assault on Parcovey Minor|raid]] on the planet [[Parcovey Minor]]. The tip allowed the [[Belasco Free Volunteers]] to rush to Parcovey Minor and foil the raid.<ref name="egw">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-5-zenith-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 5: Zenith of the Republic}}</ref>

[[File:Jilruans_with_Gar-Oth.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Two Jilruan attendants with Lord Gar-Oth]]
In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], a number of Jilruans served Lord Gar-Oth, a Yahk-Tosh warlord with significant [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces. While prospecting for an easy world to conquer and add to his [[Gar-Oth's Empire|Empire]], Gar-Oth selected a [[Lourdes' homeworld|small planetoid]] ruled by a monarchy of [[elfish humanoid]]s. Gar-Oth invaded the world, murdered its [[Lourdes' father|king]], and, in order to gain legitimacy in the eyes of the world's residents, tried to force the [[King/Legends|king's]] daughter [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Lourdes]] to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] him.<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|128|LOU 1-2|Princess Lourdes}}</ref> During Gar-Oth's administration of the planetoid, his Jilruan attendants stayed close to his side, translating his commands from [[Yahk-Tosh language|Yahk-Tosh]] into the local language.<ref name="Starcrash" />

Lord Gar-Oth's plans were interrupted when the newly promoted [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Yoshi Raph-Elan]] crash-landed on the planetoid. Evading Gar-Oth's droid forces, he met Princess Lourdes on the evening of her engagement ball and learned of the situation. Raph-Elan declared himself Lourdes' husband, prompting a violent confrontation. Learning he was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Gar-Oth ordered his droid forces to attack Raph-Elan. In the ensuing confusion, Lourdes stole a blade from a Jilruan attendant and tried to kill Gar-Oth. The quick Yakh-Tosh evaded the strike and began to strangle the woman in rage. At that point, one of the Jilruans volunteered to kill the princess on Gar-Oth's behalf. Prevented from interfering at [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-point by a local resident, [[Skeeter]], the Jilruan watched as, in a sudden reversal, Lourdes stabbed and killed Gar-Oth. Meanwhile, Raph-Elan destroyed Gar-Oth's largest droid, [[Goliath (droid)|Goliath]], causing it topple and fall on the Jilruan attendants.<ref name="Starcrash" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jilruans first appeared, albeit unidentified, in the [[Star Wars (1998) 27|twenty-seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Republic]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. The issue was written by [[Doug Petrie]], illustrated by [[Randy Green]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Starcrash" /> on [[February 28]], [[2001]].<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/00-044/Star-Wars-27Star-Crash|text=Star Wars #27: Star Crash}}</ref> They were later identified in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]],<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> which was later confirmed in two blog entries.<ref name="Blog 144">{{Blog|danwallace|144|Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 2 of 5)}}</ref><ref name="Blog 153">{{Blog|danwallace|153|Unstated Canon in Star Wars: The Essential Atlas}}</ref>
